summary: Scaffolds a beta, flag-gated PDF redaction feature: two new DB tables, a redactions page, launcher on the document page, two Trigger.dev queues, expiresIn passthrough on the presigned-URL proxy, trigger.dev 4.5.3->4.5.5. The ee/features/redaction components it imports are not in the repo.

statements.text: ✖ pages/documents/[id]/index.tsx imports redaction-launcher, which isn't in the project, so the app won't build.
statements.why: Import added in diff; file absent at this commit.

statements.text: ✖ pages/documents/[id]/redactions/[jobId].tsx imports redaction-workspace, which isn't in the project, so the app won't build.
+ Each document redaction page is new. /documents/[id]/redactions/[jobId]
• Each document page now shows the redaction launcher.
statements.why: Gated off by default (featureFlags 'redaction': false) and component missing, so not shown.

statements.text: • The s3 get presigned get URL proxy changed in a way plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Forwards caller-chosen expiresIn; still capped at 1h downstream, auth unchanged.

statements.text: • Users now also store the created redaction jobs.
statements.why: Real change is two new tables (jobs and redaction boxes) linked to documents, versions, teams, creator.

statements.text: • The agent also changed lib/trigger/queues.ts, in a way plain can't describe yet.
1. Apply prisma/migrations/20260424000000_add_redactions_model to your live database before the new code goes live.

misses.what: Beta behind the 'redaction' feature flag (off for every team by default, PDFs only); invisible unless enabled in Edge Config.
Redaction uses an AI model (Gemini, per schema comments) on document contents via Trigger.dev jobs; documents go to a third party; the tasks themselves aren't included.
